displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank, digit 2 is A, digit 1 is 3. The code is A3
meaning: Outdoor coil temperature sensor fault. The chart says the heat pump fails to operate in heating mode, and the display shows A3.
diySteps: If the heat pump will not heat and the display reads A3, leave the electrical panel closed
Technician: check the sensor connection and replace an open or shorted sensor, with power off, using the correct replacement part
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. A heat pump that will not heat on A3 is a sensor fault in this chart, not a reason to add refrigerant.
sourceTitle: Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27, PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic codes
